messages:
Riley: Support escalated a P1 for AstraNova. Trial activation blocked at SSO embed token step (403 tenant_mismatch). Session starts down ~40%. Ticket SUP-1102. Can CS pick this up?
Priya: On it. Share the error payload and whether they rotated keys recently. Need renewal window and customer tier.
Riley: Tier: Mid-market. Renewal ~36 days. Error log:
```
POST /v1/embed/token 403 {"error":"forbidden", "detail":"tenant_mismatch"}
```
They tried key rotation earlier today, no effect.
Diego: Ill check the tenant routing and mapping cache. Running a quick lookup and cache flush now: `curl -s http://mapping.internal/tenants/astra && redis-cli -h mapping-cache DEL tenant:astra` ETA 18m.
Priya: If mapping is stale we should offer a stopgap: (A) manual token issuance for their workspace, or (B) switch them to a temporary workspace while we fix. Ask Riley to confirm preference with the customer.
Riley: Customer prefers manual token to avoid redoing onboarding. I gave them a temp link and asked permission to provision manually.
csbot: Ticket SUP-1102 created and assigned to cs-oncall. Severity: P1.
Diego: Found a namespace mismatch introduced by yesterdays config roll. Rolled back the recent config to mapping-svc and cleared the per-tenant cache. Commands run: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/mapping-svc` then `redis-cli DEL tenant:astra`.
Diego: Reissued token via admin console and validated embed flow locally. Embedded widget returned 200 and user flow completed in staging tests.
Riley: Customer confirms onboarding resumed. Session starts recovering. They completed initial setup steps.
Priya: Great. Next actions: (1) CS to run a 1:1 onboarding session within 24 hours, (2) notify Sales/AM with short comms and include mitigation timeline, (3) add a tenant_id sync check to onboarding regression suite, (4) eng to add config-validation CI for mapping namespace changes. Assign owners and deadlines.
Olivia: Drafted customer comms: "Hi AstraNova team  were sorry for the interruption. A configuration mismatch caused your SSO token exchange to fail; we've restored access and can manually provision your workspace so you can continue onboarding. Weve scheduled a 1:1 session to finish setup and will follow up with a short incident summary." Posting internal note to #customers-communications and pinging Sales (Liam).
Riley: Updated SUP-1102 with logs, rollback steps, and timeline. Closing immediate loop.
Priya: Please prepare a concise postmortem in the ticket with action owners for the regression test and CI job. Tag me when ready. Thanks team!
